Dear Investigator I

| am submitting this final set of documentation to assist in your review of my complaint regarding Walmart Pharmacy #1660. The following exhibits provide a chronological record of the dispensing timeline for Rx HINNNI780 and the resulting medical outcome.

‘Summary of Documentation

* Clinical impact: Exhibit & - Status inquiry call placed 9 days after initial receipt (voicemail left by Brandon, one of the pharmacists at Walmart). As shown in Exhibit C, | required emergency medical intervention on December 6, 2025, for a medication lapse.
Exhibit D - (CURES) reflects that an emergency 3-day bridge prescription was issued by the ER physician on 12/07 while the primary order at Walmart remained undispensed.

+ Dispensing Delay: Exhibit A confirms the pharmacy was in possession of the order starting November 23, 2025. The medication was eventually dispensed 15 days later on December 8, 2025, as documented by the physical receipt in Exhibit F.
‘+ Record Review: For your investigation, please note the differing dates for this transaction across the CURES Report (Exhibit D), the Internal Expense Report (Exhibit E), and the Physical Receipt (Exhibit F),

‘The pharmacy remained in possession of a valid prescription for 15 days. During this window, administrative hurdles were presented that are contradicted by my established provider history, ultimately leading to a lapse in care and emergency medical treatment.

[have attached a Table of Exhibits and the individual fles for your review.

Thank you

Sincerely,
